proposals.rationale: This pre-turn authentication hook parses the public JSON payload’s msg and sig fields, verifies sig over the exact decoded msg bytes using ssh-keygen -Y verify, the pinned Ed25519 key, signer identity mike, and namespace mshkn, and asserts ssh:mike only on success. I tested the build and confirmed malformed signatures fail closed. Once root approves this verb, I will propose the policy that opens the public door, runs this hook, denies anonymous capabilities, and permits authenticated ssh:mike to ask me to propose changes.

verb.description: Authenticate public messages signed by Mike's pinned SSH Ed25519 key using the mshkn signature namespace. Outputs 'mike' only after successful verification.
verb.dockerfile:
FROM debian:bookworm-slim AS builder
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends jq openssh-client && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
FROM mshkn-base
COPY --from=builder /usr/bin/jq /usr/bin/jq
COPY --from=builder /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libjq.so.1 /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libjq.so.1
COPY --from=builder /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libonig.so.5 /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libonig.so.5
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'set -eu' 'payload=$1' 'msgfile=$(mktemp)' 'sigfile=$(mktemp)' 'trap '\''rm -f "$msgfile" "$sigfile"'\'' EXIT' 'printf "%s" "$payload" | jq -jer '\''.msg | select(type == "string")'\'' > "$msgfile"' 'printf "%s" "$payload" | jq -jer '\''.sig | select(type == "string")'\'' > "$sigfile"' 'printf "%s\n" "mike ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAILYgW0TAsroVv6uuC2N5pOkHqmmUB4u3VdDk3OXRVLnX" > /tmp/allowed_signers' 'ssh-keygen -Y verify -f /tmp/allowed_signers -I mike -n mshkn -s "$sigfile" < "$msgfile" >/dev/null' 'printf "%s\n" mike' > /verify.sh && chmod 0555 /verify.sh

verb.dockerfile:
FROM golang:1.24-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /src
RUN printf '%s\n' \
  'package main' \
  'import (' \
  '  "fmt"' \
  '  "io"' \
  '  "net/http"' \
  '  "os"' \
  '  "strings"' \
  '  "time"' \
  ')' \
  'const endpoint = "https://8000-comp-4e5d8ded1319.mshkn.dev/page"' \
  'const secretPath = "/run/secrets/PAGE_BEARER_TOKEN"' \
  'func main() {' \
  '  raw, err := os.ReadFile(secretPath)' \
  '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "PAGE_BEARER_TOKEN is unavailable"); os.Exit(2) }' \
  '  token := strings.TrimSpace(string(raw))' \
  '  if token == "" { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "PAGE_BEARER_TOKEN is empty"); os.Exit(2) }' \
  '  req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)' \
  '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "request setup failed"); os.Exit(2) }' \
  '  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)' \
  '  client := &http.Client{Timeout: 15 * time.Second, CheckRedirect: func(_ *http.Request, _ []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }}' \
  '  resp, err := client.Do(req)' \
  '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "request failed:", err); os.Exit(1) }' \
  '  defer resp.Body.Close()' \
  '  n, err := io.Copy(io.Discard, io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 1048577))' \
  '  if err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "response read failed:", err); os.Exit(1) }' \
  '  fmt.Printf("HTTP status: %s\nContent-Type: %s\nBody bytes read: %d\n", resp.Status, resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"), n)' \
  '  if n > 1048576 { fmt.Println("Body exceeded the 1 MiB inspection limit") }' \
  '}' > main.go
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o /out/check_bearer_page main.go
FROM mshkn-base
COPY --from=build /out/check_bearer_page /verb/check_bearer_page

RUN mkdir -p /verb && printf '%s
' '#!/bin/sh' 'set -eu' 'url=$1' 'case "$url" in' '  http://*|https://*) ;;' '  *) echo "error: URL must use http:// or https://" >&2; exit 2 ;;' 'esac' 'tmp=$(mktemp)' 'trap "rm -f "$tmp"" EXIT HUP INT TERM' 'curl --location --fail --silent --show-error --compressed --connect-timeout 8 --max-time 20 --max-redirs 5 --proto "=http,https" --proto-redir "=http,https" --range 0-1048575 --max-filesize 1048576 --user-agent "mshkn-page-title/1.0" --output "$tmp" "$url"' 'perl /verb/title.pl "$tmp"' > /verb/run.sh && printf '%s
' '#!/usr/bin/perl' 'use strict;' 'use warnings;' 'my $file = shift;' 'open my $fh, "<", $file or die "error: cannot read response
";' 'local $/;' 'my $html = <$fh>;' 'if ($html =~ m{<title [^>]*>(.*?)</title\s*>}is) {' '  my $title = $1;' '  $title =~ s/<[^>]*>//gs;' '  $title =~ s/&#x([0-9a-fA-F]+);/chr(hex($1))/ge;' '  $title =~ s/&#([0-9]+);/chr($1)/ge;' '  my %entity = (amp=>"&", lt=>"<", gt=>">", quot=>chr(34), apos=>chr(39), nbsp=>" ");' '  $title =~ s/&([A-Za-z]+);/exists $entity{lc $1} ? $entity{lc $1} : "&$1;"/ge;' '  $title =~ s/\s+/ /gs;' '  $title =~ s/^\s+|\s+$//g;' '  print "$title
";' '} else {' '  print STDERR "error: no HTML title found
";' '  exit 3;' '}' > /verb/title.pl && chmod 755 /verb/run.sh /verb/title.pl
